FROM singer s
JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON s.Singer_ID = sic.Singer_ID

    WHERE st.Name = 'Stark''s Park'

        SELECT sic3.Singer_ID
        FROM singer_in_concert sic3
        JOIN concert c3 ON sic3.concert_ID = c3.concert_ID
        WHERE c3.concert_Name = 'Home Visits'
    )
);

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(c.Year AS INTEGER) - s.Age < 1980 THEN 355 WHEN CAST(c.Year AS INTEGER) - s.Age > 1980 THEN 228 ELSE 0 END) AS Total_Pay
FROM concert c
JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID
JOIN singer s ON sic.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID
JOIN stadium st ON c.Stadium_ID = st.Stadium_ID
WHERE st.Name = 'Somerset Park';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(s.Song_release_year AS INT) - s.Age < 1980 THEN 355 ELSE 228 END) AS total_expenditure
FROM singer_in_concert sic
JOIN concert c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID
JOIN stadium st ON c.Stadium_ID = st.Stadium_ID
JOIN singer s ON sic.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID
WHERE st.Name = 'Somerset Park';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN c.Year - s.Age < 1980 THEN 355 ELSE 228 END)
FROM singer_in_concert sic

JOIN singer s ON sic.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID

WITH john_age AS (
  SELECT Age - 3 AS adjusted_age 
  FROM singer 
  WHERE Name = 'Justin Brown'
)
SELECT SUM(
  CASE 
    WHEN (c.Year - CASE WHEN s.Name = 'John Nizinik' THEN (SELECT adjusted_age FROM john_age) ELSE s.Age END) < 1980 
    THEN 355 
    ELSE 228 
  END
) AS total_expenditure
FROM singer_in_concert sc
JOIN concert c ON sc.concert_ID = c.concert_ID
JOIN singer s ON sc.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID
JOIN stadium st ON c.Stadium_ID = st.Stadium_ID
WHERE st.Name = 'Somerset Park';

SELECT s.Name, COUNT(c.concert_ID) AS concert_count
FROM stadium s
LEFT JOIN concert c ON s.Stadium_ID = c.Stadium_ID
WHERE s.Average = (SELECT MIN(Average) FROM stadium)
   OR s.Average = (SELECT MAX(Average) FROM stadium)
GROUP BY s.Stadium_ID, s.Name
ORDER BY s.Average;

SELECT s.Name, COUNT(c.concert_ID) AS concert_count
FROM stadium s
LEFT JOIN concert c ON s.Stadium_ID = CAST(c.Stadium_ID AS INTEGER)
WHERE s.Average = (SELECT MAX(Average) FROM stadium)
GROUP BY s.Stadium_ID, s.Name
UNION ALL
SELECT s.Name, COUNT(c.concert_ID)
FROM stadium s
LEFT JOIN concert c ON s.Stadium_ID = CAST(c.Stadium_ID AS INTEGER)
WHERE s.Average = (SELECT MIN(Average) FROM stadium)
GROUP BY s.Stadium_ID, s.Name;

WITH
hampden_cap AS (SELECT Capacity FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Hampden Park'),
modified_stadium AS (
    SELECT s.*,
        CASE WHEN s.Name = 'Gayfield Park' THEN (SELECT Capacity FROM hampden_cap) / 10.0
             ELSE s.Capacity * 1.0
        END AS adj_capacity
    FROM stadium s
),
attendance_rate AS (
    SELECT Name, Average, adj_capacity, Average / adj_capacity AS rate
    FROM modified_stadium
),
concert_counts AS (
    SELECT s.Name, COUNT(c.concert_ID) AS concert_count
    FROM stadium s LEFT JOIN concert c ON s.Stadium_ID = c.Stadium_ID
    GROUP BY s.Name
)
SELECT ar.Name AS Stadium, ar.rate AS Attendance_Rate, cc.concert_count AS Number_of_Concerts
FROM attendance_rate ar
JOIN concert_counts cc ON ar.Name = cc.Name
WHERE ar.rate = (SELECT MIN(rate) FROM attendance_rate)
   OR ar.rate = (SELECT MAX(rate) FROM attendance_rate)
ORDER BY ar.rate;

WITH rates AS (
  SELECT Stadium_ID, Name, CAST(Average AS REAL) / Capacity AS rate
  FROM stadium
)
SELECT r.Name AS Stadium_Name, COUNT(c.concert_ID) AS Number_of_Concerts
FROM rates r
LEFT JOIN concert c ON CAST(r.Stadium_ID AS TEXT) = c.Stadium_ID
WHERE r.rate = (SELECT MAX(rate) FROM rates)
   OR r.rate = (SELECT MIN(rate) FROM rates)
GROUP BY r.Stadium_ID, r.Name;

SELECT c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name,
       CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN s.Is_male = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(sic.Singer_ID) * 100 AS female_percentage
FROM concert c
JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID
JOIN singer s ON sic.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID
JOIN stadium st ON c.Stadium_ID = st.Stadium_ID
WHERE st.Name = 'Somerset Park'
GROUP BY c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name;

SELECT c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name, 
       100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.Is_male = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS female_percentage
FROM concert c
JOIN stadium st ON c.Stadium_ID = st.Stadium_ID
JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID
JOIN singer s ON sic.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID

FROM concert c
JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID

FROM concert
WHERE CAST(Stadium_ID AS INTEGER) IN (
  SELECT Stadium_ID
  FROM stadium
  ORDER BY Average DESC

WITH total AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM concert
),
top3 AS (
    SELECT Stadium_ID FROM stadium ORDER BY Average DESC LIMIT 3
),
modified_concerts AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN Theme = 'Bleeding Love' THEN (SELECT Stadium_ID FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Glebe Park')
            ELSE Stadium_ID
        END AS new_stadium_id
    FROM concert
)
SELECT (COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT cnt FROM total)) AS percentage
FROM modified_concerts
WHERE new_stadium_id IN (SELECT Stadium_ID FROM top3);

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN c.Theme = 'Bleeding Love' THEN (SELECT s.Stadium_ID FROM stadium s WHERE s.Name = 'Glebe Park') ELSE CAST(c.Stadium_ID AS INTEGER) END) IN (SELECT Stadium_ID FROM stadium ORDER BY Average DESC LIMIT 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM concert c;

WITH 
somerset_id AS (SELECT Stadium_ID FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Somerset Park'),
balmoor_id AS (SELECT Stadium_ID FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Balmoor'),
glebe_id AS (SELECT Stadium_ID FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Glebe Park'),
singer_counts AS (
    SELECT s.Stadium_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID) as cnt
    FROM stadium s
    LEFT JOIN concert c ON s.Stadium_ID = c.Stadium_ID
    LEFT JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID
    GROUP BY s.Stadium_ID
),
somerset_singers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID
    FROM singer_in_concert sic
    JOIN concert c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID
    JOIN stadium s ON c.Stadium_ID = s.Stadium_ID
    WHERE s.Name = 'Somerset Park'
),
balmoor_singers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID
    FROM singer_in_concert sic
    JOIN concert c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID
    JOIN stadium s ON c.Stadium_ID = s.Stadium_ID
    WHERE s.Name = 'Balmoor'
),
condition_check AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM somerset_singers WHERE Singer_ID NOT IN (SELECT Singer_ID FROM balmoor_singers)
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS condition_holds
),
glebe_count AS (
    SELECT cnt FROM singer_counts WHERE Stadium_ID = (SELECT Stadium_ID FROM glebe_id)
)
SELECT s.Name
FROM stadium s
JOIN singer_counts sc ON s.Stadium_ID = sc.Stadium_ID
WHERE sc.cnt >= 3 * (SELECT cnt FROM glebe_count)
AND (SELECT condition_holds FROM condition_check) = 1;

WITH
somerset_singers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID
    FROM singer_in_concert sic
    JOIN concert c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID
    JOIN stadium s ON c.Stadium_ID = s.Stadium_ID
    WHERE s.Name COLLATE NOCASE = 'Somerset Park'
),
balmoor_singers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID
    FROM singer_in_concert sic
    JOIN concert c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID
    JOIN stadium s ON c.Stadium_ID = s.Stadium_ID
    WHERE s.Name COLLATE NOCASE = 'Balmoor stadium'
),
intersected AS (
    SELECT Singer_ID FROM somerset_singers
    INTERSECT
    SELECT Singer_ID FROM balmoor_singers
),
glebe_park_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID) AS cnt
    FROM singer_in_concert sic
    JOIN concert c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID
    JOIN stadium s ON c.Stadium_ID = s.Stadium_ID
    WHERE s.Name COLLATE NOCASE = 'Glebe Park'
      AND sic.Singer_ID IN (SELECT Singer_ID FROM intersected)
)
SELECT s.Name
FROM stadium s
JOIN concert c ON s.Stadium_ID = c.Stadium_ID
JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID
WHERE sic.Singer_ID IN (SELECT Singer_ID FROM intersected)
GROUP BY s.Stadium_ID, s.Name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID) >= 3 * (SELECT cnt FROM glebe_park_count);
SELECT Name FROM stadium WHERE Highest > 2 * (SELECT Highest FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Balmoor');
SELECT Name FROM stadium WHERE Highest > 2 * (SELECT Highest FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Balmoor') AND Name <> 'Balmoor';
SELECT Name FROM stadium WHERE Highest > 2 * (SELECT Highest FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Balmoor');
SELECT Name FROM stadium WHERE Highest > 2 * (SELECT Highest FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Balmoor' AND Capacity = 5600);

SELECT c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name, COUNT(sic.Singer_ID) AS singer_count
FROM concert c
JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID
WHERE c.Year > '2012'
GROUP BY c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name
HAVING COUNT(sic.Singer_ID) > (
    SELECT COUNT(sic2.Singer_ID)
    FROM concert c2
    JOIN singer_in_concert sic2 ON c2.concert_ID = sic2.concert_ID
    WHERE c2.Theme = 'Happy Tonight'
);

WITH happy AS (
  SELECT c.concert_ID, COUNT(sic.Singer_ID) AS singer_count
  FROM concert c
  JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID
  WHERE c.Theme = 'Happy Tonight'
  GROUP BY c.concert_ID
)
SELECT c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name,
       CAST(COUNT(sic.Singer_ID) AS REAL) / happy.singer_count AS ratio
FROM concert c
JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID
CROSS JOIN happy
WHERE c.Year > '2012'
GROUP BY c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name
HAVING COUNT(sic.Singer_ID) > happy.singer_count;

SELECT c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name, COUNT(sic.Singer_ID) AS singer_count
FROM concert c
JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID
WHERE CAST(c.Year AS INTEGER) > 2012
GROUP BY c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name
HAVING COUNT(sic.Singer_ID) > (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM concert c2
    JOIN singer_in_concert sic2 ON c2.concert_ID = sic2.concert_ID
    WHERE c2.Theme = 'Happy Tonight'
);

SELECT c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name,
       CAST(COUNT(sic.Singer_ID) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM singer_in_concert WHERE concert_ID = (SELECT concert_ID FROM concert WHERE Theme = 'Happy Tonight')) AS ratio
FROM concert c
JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID
WHERE c.Year > '2012'
GROUP BY c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name
HAVING COUNT(sic.Singer_ID) > (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM singer_in_concert WHERE concert_ID = (SELECT concert_ID FROM concert WHERE Theme = 'Happy Tonight'));

SELECT s.Name
FROM singer s,
     (SELECT CAST(Song_release_year AS INTEGER) AS love_year, Age AS love_age
      FROM singer
      WHERE Song_Name = 'Love') love
WHERE (s.Age + (love.love_year - CAST(s.Song_release_year AS INTEGER))) > 2 * love.love_age;

SELECT s.Name
FROM singer s,
  (SELECT Age, CAST(Song_release_year AS INTEGER) AS release_year
   FROM singer
   WHERE Song_Name = 'Love') AS l
WHERE (s.Age + (l.release_year - CAST(s.Song_release_year AS INTEGER))) > 2 * l.Age;
SELECT Name FROM singer WHERE (2010 - (CAST(Song_release_year AS INTEGER) - Age)) > 2 * (SELECT Age FROM singer WHERE Song_Name = 'Love' AND Song_release_year = '2010');

SELECT Name
FROM singer
WHERE Age + (2010 - CAST(Song_release_year AS INTEGER)) >
    (SELECT 2 * Age
     FROM singer
     WHERE Song_Name = 'Love' AND CAST(Song_release_year AS INTEGER) = 2010 
     LIMIT 1);

SELECT Continent
FROM country
WHERE Population > 0 AND GNP IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (GNP * 1.0 / Population) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Continent 
FROM country 
WHERE GNP * 1.0 / Population = (
    SELECT MAX(GNP * 1.0 / Population) 
    FROM country 
    WHERE Population > 0 AND GNP IS NOT NULL
);

SELECT Continent
FROM country
WHERE Population > 0
  AND (GNP IS NOT NULL OR Code = (SELECT CountryCode FROM city WHERE Name='Korla'))
ORDER BY CASE
           WHEN Code = (SELECT CountryCode FROM city WHERE Name='Korla')
           THEN 1982268.0
           ELSE GNP
         END / Population DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT Continent FROM country ORDER BY (CASE WHEN Code = (SELECT CountryCode FROM city WHERE Name = 'Korla') THEN 1982268 ELSE GNP END) * 1.0 / Population DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT Name
FROM country
WHERE IndepYear > 1979
  AND GNPOld IS NOT NULL
  AND GNPOld != 0
ORDER BY (GNP - GNPOld) / GNPOld DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT Name FROM country WHERE IndepYear > 1979 AND GNPOld > 0 ORDER BY (GNP - GNPOld) / GNPOld DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT Name FROM country WHERE Continent = 'Oceania' AND IndepYear > 1979 AND GNP IS NOT NULL ORDER BY GNP ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT Name FROM country WHERE Continent = 'Oceania' AND IndepYear > 1979 AND GNP > 0 ORDER BY GNP ASC LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.Name AS HighestDensityCountry,
       (MAX(density) / MIN(density)) AS TimesLarger
FROM (
    SELECT c.Name,
           (c.Population * 1.0 / c.SurfaceArea) AS density
    FROM country c
    JOIN countrylanguage cl ON c.Code = cl.CountryCode
    WHERE cl.Language = 'English'
      AND cl.Percentage > 50
) sub;

WITH english_top AS (
    SELECT cl.CountryCode
    FROM countrylanguage cl
    WHERE cl.Language = 'English'
      AND cl.Percentage = (
          SELECT MAX(cl2.Percentage)
          FROM countrylanguage cl2
          WHERE cl2.CountryCode = cl.CountryCode
      )
),
density AS (
    SELECT c.Name, CAST(c.Population AS REAL) / c.SurfaceArea AS Density
    FROM country c
    INNER JOIN english_top e ON c.Code = e.CountryCode
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT Name FROM density ORDER BY Density DESC LIMIT 1) AS Country,
    (SELECT MAX(Density) / MIN(Density) FROM density) AS Ratio;

WITH english_majority AS (
  SELECT CountryCode
  FROM countrylanguage
  WHERE Language = 'English' AND Percentage > 50
),
densities AS (
  SELECT c.Name, CAST(c.Population AS REAL) / c.SurfaceArea AS density
  FROM country c
  JOIN english_majority e ON c.Code = e.CountryCode
  WHERE c.Code <> 'IRL' AND c.SurfaceArea > 0
)
SELECT d.Name AS country,
       (SELECT MAX(density) FROM densities) / (SELECT MIN(density) FROM densities) AS ratio
FROM densities d
ORDER BY d.density DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH eng_dominant AS (
    SELECT c.Name, c.Population, c.SurfaceArea
    FROM country c
    JOIN countrylanguage cl ON c.Code = cl.CountryCode
    WHERE cl.Language = 'English'
      AND cl.Percentage = (SELECT MAX(cl2.Percentage) FROM countrylanguage cl2 WHERE cl2.CountryCode = c.Code)
      AND c.Name != 'Ireland'
),
density AS (
    SELECT Name, Population * 1.0 / SurfaceArea AS pop_density
    FROM eng_dominant
    WHERE SurfaceArea > 0
)
SELECT
    (SELECT Name FROM density ORDER BY pop_density DESC LIMIT 1) AS CountryWithHighestDensity,
    (SELECT MAX(pop_density) / MIN(pop_density) FROM density) AS Ratio
FROM (SELECT 1) dummy;

SELECT c.Name
FROM country c
WHERE c.GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND c.GNPOld > 0
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM countrylanguage cl
    WHERE cl.CountryCode = c.Code
      AND cl.Language = 'Arabic'
      AND cl.IsOfficial = 'T'
  )
ORDER BY (c.GNP - c.GNPOld) * 1.0 / c.GNPOld DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.Name
FROM country c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM countrylanguage cl
  WHERE cl.CountryCode = c.Code
    AND cl.IsOfficial = 'T'
    AND cl.Language = 'Arabic'
)
AND c.GNP IS NOT NULL
AND c.GNPOld IS NOT NULL
AND c.GNPOld > 0
ORDER BY (c.GNP - c.GNPOld) / c.GNPOld DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.Name
FROM country c
LEFT JOIN countrylanguage cl ON c.Code = cl.CountryCode
                             AND cl.Language = 'Arabic'
                             AND cl.IsOfficial = 'T'
WHERE cl.CountryCode IS NULL
  AND c.GNP IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE(CASE WHEN c.Continent = 'South America'
                    THEN c.GNPOld + 9999.0
                    ELSE c.GNPOld END, 0) > 0
ORDER BY (c.GNP - COALESCE(CASE WHEN c.Continent = 'South America'
                                THEN c.GNPOld + 9999.0
                                ELSE c.GNPOld END, 0))
         / COALESCE(CASE WHEN c.Continent = 'South America'
                        THEN c.GNPOld + 9999.0
                        ELSE c.GNPOld END, 0) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.Name
FROM country c
WHERE c.Continent = 'South America'
  AND c.GNP IS NOT NULL
  AND c.GNPOld IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM countrylanguage cl
    WHERE cl.CountryCode = c.Code AND cl.IsOfficial = 'T'
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM countrylanguage cl
    WHERE cl.CountryCode = c.Code AND cl.IsOfficial = 'T' AND cl.Language = 'Arabic'
  )
ORDER BY (c.GNP - (c.GNPOld + 9999.0)) / (c.GNPOld + 9999.0) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT city.Name
FROM city
JOIN country ON city.CountryCode = country.Code
WHERE country.Continent = 'North America'
AND city.Population >= 2 * (SELECT Population FROM city WHERE Name = 'Kang-won');

SELECT c.Name
FROM city c

WHERE co.Continent = 'North America'
  AND c.Population >= 2 * (
    SELECT Population
    FROM city
    WHERE Name = 'Kang-won'
  )
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.Name FROM city c JOIN country co ON c.CountryCode = co.Code JOIN countrylanguage cl ON co.Code = cl.CountryCode WHERE co.Continent = 'North America' AND cl.Language = 'English' AND cl.IsOfficial = 'T' AND c.Population * 1.01 >= 2 * (SELECT SUM(Population) FROM city WHERE District = 'Kang-won') ORDER BY c.Population DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT city.Name
FROM city
JOIN country ON city.CountryCode = country.Code
WHERE country.Continent = 'North America'
AND city.Population * CASE WHEN city.CountryCode IN (
  SELECT country.Code FROM country
  JOIN countrylanguage ON country.Code = countrylanguage.CountryCode
  WHERE country.Continent = 'North America' AND countrylanguage.Language = 'English' AND countrylanguage.IsOfficial = 'T'
) THEN 1.01 ELSE 1.0 END >= 2 * (SELECT Population FROM city WHERE Name = 'Kang-won')
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Continent
FROM country
WHERE GNP IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld != 0
GROUP BY Continent
HAVING SUM(GNPOld) > 0
   AND (SUM(GNP) - SUM(GNPOld)) * 1.0 / SUM(GNPOld) >=
       1.5 * (
           SELECT (SUM(GNP) - SUM(GNPOld)) * 1.0 / SUM(GNPOld)
           FROM country
           WHERE Continent = 'Africa'
             AND GNP IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld != 0
             AND (SELECT SUM(GNPOld) FROM country WHERE Continent = 'Africa' AND GNP IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld != 0) > 0
       );

SELECT continent
FROM (
  SELECT continent, SUM(GNP) AS total_gnp, SUM(GNPOld) AS total_gnpold
  FROM country
  WHERE GNP IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY continent
)
WHERE (total_gnp - total_gnpold) / total_gnpold >= 
  1.5 * (
    SELECT (SUM(GNP) - SUM(GNPOld)) / SUM(GNPOld)
    FROM country
    WHERE continent = 'Africa' AND GNP IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld IS NOT NULL
  );

WITH czech_countries AS (
    SELECT CountryCode
    FROM countrylanguage
    WHERE Language = 'Czech' AND Percentage > 50
),
continent_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Continent,
        SUM(c.GNP) AS orig_gnp,
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.Code IN (SELECT CountryCode FROM czech_countries) THEN c.GNP * 1.005 ELSE c.GNP END) AS new_gnp
    FROM country c
    WHERE c.GNP IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY c.Continent
),
africa_growth AS (
    SELECT (new_gnp - orig_gnp) / orig_gnp AS growth
    FROM continent_totals
    WHERE Continent = 'Africa' AND orig_gnp > 0
)
SELECT ct.Continent
FROM continent_totals ct, africa_growth ag
WHERE ct.orig_gnp > 0
  AND (ct.new_gnp - ct.orig_gnp) / ct.orig_gnp >= 1.5 * ag.growth;

WITH czech_dom AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CountryCode
  FROM countrylanguage
  WHERE Language = 'Czech'
    AND Percentage = (SELECT MAX(Percentage) FROM countrylanguage cl2 WHERE cl2.CountryCode = countrylanguage.CountryCode)
),
continent_stats AS (
  SELECT
    co.Continent,
    SUM(co.GNP) AS old_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.CountryCode IS NOT NULL THEN co.GNP * 1.005 ELSE co.GNP END) AS new_total
  FROM country co
  LEFT JOIN czech_dom c ON co.Code = c.CountryCode
  WHERE co.GNP IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY co.Continent
),
africa_growth AS (
  SELECT (new_total - old_total) / old_total * 100 AS growth
  FROM continent_stats
  WHERE Continent = 'Africa'
)
SELECT cs.Continent
FROM continent_stats cs
CROSS JOIN africa_growth af
WHERE (cs.new_total - cs.old_total) / cs.old_total * 100 >= 1.5 * af.growth
ORDER BY cs.Continent;
SELECT `Name` FROM `country` WHERE `LifeExpectancy` >= 1.5 * (SELECT `LifeExpectancy` FROM `country` WHERE `Name` = 'Zambia');
SELECT Name FROM country WHERE LifeExpectancy >= (SELECT 1.5 * LifeExpectancy FROM country WHERE Name = 'Zambia');

SELECT Name
FROM (
    SELECT Name, LifeExpectancy
    FROM country
    WHERE GNP IS NOT NULL AND Population > 0
    ORDER BY (GNP * 1000000.0) / Population DESC
    LIMIT 20
) top20
WHERE LifeExpectancy >= (
    SELECT 1.5 * LifeExpectancy
    FROM country
    WHERE Name = 'Zambia'
);

WITH
top20 AS (
  SELECT Code
  FROM country
  WHERE Population > 0 AND GNP IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY (GNP * 1.0 / Population) DESC
  LIMIT 20
),
zambia_le AS (
  SELECT LifeExpectancy AS le
  FROM country
  WHERE Name = 'Zambia'
)
SELECT c.Name
FROM country c, zambia_le
WHERE (CASE WHEN c.Code IN (SELECT Code FROM top20) THEN 90.0 ELSE c.LifeExpectancy END) >= 1.5 * zambia_le.le;

SELECT c.Name
FROM country c
JOIN (
    SELECT cl1.CountryCode, cl1.Language
    FROM countrylanguage cl1
    WHERE cl1.Percentage = (
        SELECT MAX(cl2.Percentage)
        FROM countrylanguage cl2
        WHERE cl2.CountryCode = cl1.CountryCode
    )
) main_lang ON c.Code = main_lang.CountryCode
WHERE main_lang.Language <> 'Dutch'
  AND c.GNP IS NOT NULL
  AND c.GNPOld IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (c.GNPOld - c.GNP) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.Name
FROM country c
WHERE c.GNP IS NOT NULL AND c.GNPOld IS NOT NULL
AND c.Code NOT IN (
    SELECT cl.CountryCode
    FROM countrylanguage cl
    WHERE cl.Language = 'Dutch'
    AND cl.Percentage = (
        SELECT MAX(cl2.Percentage)
        FROM countrylanguage cl2
        WHERE cl2.CountryCode = cl.CountryCode
    )
)
ORDER BY (c.GNPOld - c.GNP) DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH modified_cl AS (SELECT CountryCode, Language, IsOfficial, Percentage FROM countrylanguage WHERE CountryCode != 'ABW' UNION ALL SELECT 'ABW', 'Dutch', 'T', 100.0), main_lang AS (SELECT CountryCode, Language, Percentage, MAX(Percentage) OVER (PARTITION BY CountryCode) AS max_pct FROM modified_cl), dutch_non_main AS (SELECT CountryCode, Percentage FROM main_lang WHERE Language = 'Dutch' AND Percentage < max_pct) SELECT c.Name FROM dutch_non_main d JOIN country c ON d.CountryCode = c.Code WHERE c.GNP IS NOT NULL ORDER BY c.GNP * (d.Percentage / 100.0) DESC LIMIT 1

WITH primary_lang AS (
    SELECT CountryCode,
           CASE WHEN CountryCode = 'ABW' THEN 'Dutch' ELSE Language END AS Language
    FROM (
        SELECT CountryCode, Language,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CountryCode ORDER BY Percentage DESC) AS rn
        FROM countrylanguage
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT c.Name
FROM country c
JOIN primary_lang pl ON c.Code = pl.CountryCode
WHERE pl.Language != 'Dutch'
  AND c.GNP IS NOT NULL
  AND c.GNPOld IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (c.GNP - c.GNPOld) ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM country WHERE Continent='North America' AND GNP < GNPOld) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM country WHERE Continent='South America' AND GNP < GNPOld);
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM country WHERE Continent = 'North America' AND GNP < GNPOld) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM country WHERE Continent = 'South America' AND GNP < GNPOld) AS difference;

WITH top2na AS (
    SELECT Code 
    FROM country 
    WHERE Continent = 'North America' 
    ORDER BY Population DESC 
    LIMIT 2
),
adj AS (
    SELECT
        c.Code,
        c.Continent,
        CASE WHEN c.Code IN (SELECT Code FROM top2na) 
             THEN c.GNP * 1.02 
             ELSE c.GNP 
        END AS adj_gnp,
        c.GNPOld
    FROM country c
    WHERE c.Continent IN ('North America', 'South America')
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM adj WHERE Continent = 'North America' AND adj_gnp < GNPOld) -
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM adj WHERE Continent = 'South America' AND adj_gnp < GNPOld) AS difference;

WITH top2 AS (SELECT Code FROM country WHERE Continent = 'North America' ORDER BY Population DESC LIMIT 2)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.Continent = 'North America' AND (CASE WHEN c.Code IN (SELECT Code FROM top2) THEN c.GNP * 1.02 ELSE c.GNP END) < c.GNPOld THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)
  -
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.Continent = 'South America' AND c.GNP < c.GNPOld THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS difference
FROM country c
WHERE c.Continent IN ('North America', 'South America');

SELECT Continent
FROM country
WHERE GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld > 0
GROUP BY Continent
HAVING (SUM(GNP) - SUM(GNPOld)) * 1.0 / SUM(GNPOld) >= (
    SELECT (SUM(GNP) - SUM(GNPOld)) * 1.0 / SUM(GNPOld)
    FROM country
    WHERE Continent = 'Europe'
      AND GNPOld IS NOT NULL
      AND GNPOld > 0
) + 0.02
AND Continent != 'Europe';

SELECT Continent
FROM (
  SELECT Continent, (SUM(GNP) - SUM(GNPOld)) * 100.0 / SUM(GNPOld) AS growth_rate
  FROM country
  WHERE GNP IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld != 0
  GROUP BY Continent
) AS continent_growth
WHERE Continent != 'Europe'
  AND growth_rate >= COALESCE(
      (SELECT (SUM(GNP) - SUM(GNPOld)) * 100.0 / SUM(GNPOld)
       FROM country
       WHERE Continent = 'Europe' AND GNP IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld != 0),
      -9999
    ) + 2
LIMIT 1;

WITH
top3 AS (
    SELECT Code
    FROM country
    WHERE LifeExpectancy IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY LifeExpectancy DESC
    LIMIT 3
),
adj AS (
    SELECT Continent,
           SUM(Population) AS TotalPop,
           SUM(CASE WHEN c.Code IN (SELECT Code FROM top3) THEN c.GNP * 0.98 ELSE c.GNP END) AS AdjGNP,
           SUM(GNP) AS OrigGNP
    FROM country c
    GROUP BY Continent
),
percap AS (
    SELECT Continent,
           CAST(OrigGNP AS REAL) / NULLIF(TotalPop, 0) AS OrigPC,
           CAST(AdjGNP AS REAL) / NULLIF(TotalPop, 0) AS AdjPC
    FROM adj
),
rates AS (
    SELECT Continent,
           (AdjPC - OrigPC) / NULLIF(OrigPC, 0) * 100 AS GrowthRate
    FROM percap
    WHERE OrigPC IS NOT NULL
),
europe_rate AS (
    SELECT GrowthRate AS EurRate FROM rates WHERE Continent = 'Europe'
)
SELECT r.Continent
FROM rates r, europe_rate er
WHERE (r.GrowthRate - er.EurRate) >= 2;

WITH top3 AS (
  SELECT Code FROM country ORDER BY LifeExpectancy DESC LIMIT 3
),
continent_growth AS (
  SELECT 
    c.Continent,
    100.0 * ( 
      SUM(CASE WHEN c.Code IN (SELECT Code FROM top3) THEN c.GNP * 0.98 ELSE c.GNP END) / SUM(c.Population)
      ) / ( SUM(c.GNP) / SUM(c.Population) ) - 100.0 AS growth_rate
  FROM country c
  WHERE c.GNP IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.Continent
  HAVING SUM(c.GNP) > 0 AND SUM(c.Population) > 0
)
SELECT DISTINCT Continent
FROM continent_growth
WHERE Continent <> 'Europe'
  AND growth_rate - (SELECT growth_rate FROM continent_growth WHERE Continent = 'Europe') >= 2;
SELECT Name, GNPOld, GNP, GNP + (GNP - GNPOld) AS FutureGNP FROM country WHERE Continent = 'Asia';

WITH chinese_main AS (
    SELECT CountryCode
    FROM countrylanguage
    WHERE Language = 'Chinese'
    ORDER BY Percentage DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    c.Name,
    c.GNPOld AS past_GNP,
    CASE WHEN c.Code = cm.CountryCode THEN 1000000.0 ELSE c.GNP END AS current_GNP,
    (CASE WHEN c.Code = cm.CountryCode THEN 1000000.0 ELSE c.GNP END *
     CASE WHEN c.Code = cm.CountryCode THEN 1000000.0 ELSE c.GNP END) /
    NULLIF(c.GNPOld, 0.0) AS future_GNP
FROM country c
CROSS JOIN chinese_main cm
WHERE c.Continent = 'Asia';

WITH china AS (
    SELECT cl.CountryCode
    FROM countrylanguage cl
    JOIN country c ON cl.CountryCode = c.Code
    WHERE cl.Language = 'Chinese' AND c.Continent = 'Asia'
    ORDER BY cl.Percentage DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    c.Name,
    c.GNPOld AS PastGNP,
    CASE WHEN c.Code = china.CountryCode THEN 1000000.0 ELSE c.GNP END AS CurrentGNP,
    CASE
        WHEN c.GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND c.GNPOld > 0 THEN
            (CASE WHEN c.Code = china.CountryCode THEN 1000000.0 ELSE c.GNP END)
            * (CASE WHEN c.Code = china.CountryCode THEN 1000000.0 ELSE c.GNP END)
            / c.GNPOld
        ELSE NULL
    END AS FutureGNP
FROM country c, china
WHERE c.Continent = 'Asia';

WITH europe_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(c.GNP * 1.0 / c.Population) AS avg_gnp_pc
  FROM country c
  WHERE c.Continent = 'Europe'
    AND c.GNP IS NOT NULL
    AND c.Population > 0
),
zambia_data AS (
  SELECT c.IndepYear, c.LifeExpectancy, (c.GNP * 1.0 / c.Population) AS gnp_pc
  FROM country c
  WHERE c.Name = 'Zambia'
)
SELECT CAST(
  zd.IndepYear + zd.LifeExpectancy + 
  CASE WHEN zd.gnp_pc > (SELECT avg_gnp_pc FROM europe_avg) THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
  AS INTEGER) AS predicted_death_year
FROM zambia_data zd;
